title: OA LEARNING MARTIAL ARTS - the master search and acceptance, the study obligations and slot costs, with the multiple styles and the combining of styles
audit_label: R695 OA learning martial arts audit
audit_comment: OA round eighty-two (capture pp. 233-235): the Learning Martial Arts prose - the master search, the acceptance and challenge routes, the study obligations and proficiency slot costs - with the Multiple Styles and Combining Styles rules, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA LEARNING MARTIAL ARTS, printed capture pp. 233-235 - the masters, study and styles round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE MASTERS: the honorary title no character class - the brilliant, the skilled, the mediocre and the incompetent all called master; anyone anywhere - the peasant, the hermit, the traveling bushi, the professional teacher, the famous samurai, the temple priest; the scarcity - the select few, the unadvertised skill, the seclusion, the politics and the secret societies, the styles vanished with refusing masters; the schools of the towns and cities. THE ACCEPTANCE: the untrained character's 10% chance at the properly humble presentation; the courting - each gift-bearing visit +10%, until accepted or the master offended, the offense permanent; the skilled character's challenge, automatically accepted, the unknown challenger given a student; the subdue preferred over the death, the death no crime; the victor automatically accepted, the loser returning later or humbly begging. THE MASTER'S KNOWLEDGE: the basics automatic; the weapons and the maneuvers each rolled on the nearest die equal to or greater than their count; the maneuvers always from the lowest difficulty upward; the master fixed, never increasing without the DM's special circumstances. THE STUDY: the one-month minimum before the one slot buys the basics - the AC, the attacks, the damage, no maneuvers or weapons yet; then the travel and adventure with the one hour of daily practice and the six weekly master hours, the obligation unfulfilled blocking all additions; one slot per maneuver or weapon, no more than two slots per style per level, the strict difficulty order, the practice assumed; the outgrown master left for another. THE STYLES: more than one learned at a time - more than one master, the slots and the dedication; the fighting choice of a single style, its abilities alone, the constant maneuvers the exception; the change from round to round; the combining after all is learned - the unique style of mixed elements, the AC of one with the attacks and damage of another, every learned maneuver combined, the creator instructing others as a master. The grid mechanics codified per the R431 calculus

consts.name: djiAcceptBasePct
consts.comment: the acceptance chance - the untrained character presenting himself with the proper humble and respectful attitude has a 10% chance of being accepted outright (print capture p. 234)

consts.name: djiAcceptGiftPct
consts.comment: the courting increment - each return visit bearing a small gift or offering that pleases the master increases the acceptance chance by 10% (print capture p. 234)

consts.name: djiStudyMinMonths
consts.comment: the study minimum - once accepted the character must remain and study under the master for at least one month (print capture p. 235)

consts.name: djiPracticeHoursPerDay
consts.comment: the daily practice - at least one hour a day of practicing the style once free to travel and adventure (print capture p. 235)

consts.name: djiMasterHoursPerWeek
consts.comment: the weekly master hours - six hours per week working with the master, the unfulfilled obligation blocking new special maneuvers and weapons (print capture p. 235)

consts.name: djiSlotsPerManeuver
consts.comment: the maneuver slot cost - one proficiency slot expended per special maneuver or weapon added to the style (print capture p. 235)

consts.name: djiMaxSlotsPerLevel
consts.comment: the per-level cap - no more than two proficiency slots expended on a single martial arts style per level (print capture p. 235)

consts.name: djiStylesKnownMin
consts.comment: the combining threshold - proficiency in two or more styles, all learned from those masters, before the unique style can be created (print capture p. 235)

bools.name: djiMasterHonoraryTitle
bools.comment: the master title - an honorary title, not a character class; brilliant, skilled, mediocre and incompetent masters all exist, the title no measure of skill or level (print capture p. 233)

bools.name: djiMasterAnywhere
bools.comment: the masters - anyone, anywhere: the peasant in the field, the hermit in the hills, the traveling bushi, the professional teacher, the famous samurai, the temple priest (print capture p. 233)

bools.name: djiMasterSecretive
bools.comment: the master scarcity - the skills taught to a select few, often unadvertised, the seclusion preferred, the styles vanished with refusing masters, the politics and the secret societies (print capture p. 234)

bools.name: djiOffendNeverAccepted
bools.comment: the offended master - once offended he will never accept the character as his student, the courting ended (print capture p. 234)

bools.name: djiChallengeAutoAccepted
bools.comment: the challenge route - the character with martial arts skill challenges the master, the challenge automatically accepted, a time and place arranged (print capture p. 234)

bools.name: djiStudentIfUnknown
bools.comment: the unknown challenger - a student automatically assigned when the character is not well-known for his skill, customary and no insult (print capture p. 234)

bools.name: djiChallengeSubduePreferred
bools.comment: the challenge forms - fought to subdue or to the death, the subdue preferred, the death no crime and the victor seldom punished (print capture p. 234)

bools.name: djiChallengeWinAccepted
bools.comment: the won challenge - the master automatically accepts the victor as his student (print capture p. 234)

bools.name: djiChallengeLoseOptions
bools.comment: the lost challenge - leave and return later with more skill, or humbly beg acceptance, the entreaty effective after the humiliating ease (print capture p. 234)

bools.name: djiMasterBasicsAuto
bools.comment: the master's basics - he automatically knows the basics of the style, the Armor Class and the like (print capture p. 234)

bools.name: djiMasterWeaponsDie
bools.comment: the master's weapons - the number of weapons of the style counted, the nearest die equal to or greater rolled for his proficiencies (print capture p. 234)

bools.name: djiMasterManeuversDie
bools.comment: the master's maneuvers - the special maneuvers totaled, the nearest die equal to or greater rolled, always known from the lowest difficulty upward (print capture p. 234)

bools.name: djiMasterNeverIncreases
bools.comment: the master fixed - he never increases in knowledge unless the DM rules special circumstances (print capture p. 234)

bools.name: djiBasicsSlotGrant
bools.comment: the basics grant - one proficiency slot spent at the month's end gains the Armor Class, number of attacks and damage, no special maneuvers or weapons yet (print capture p. 235)

bools.name: djiObligationGate
bools.comment: the obligation gate - characters not fulfilling the practice and master hours cannot add more special maneuvers and weapons (print capture p. 235)

bools.name: djiManeuverPracticeAssumed
bools.comment: the added maneuver - assumes prior practice, no sudden knowledge; the maneuvers learned in strict difficulty order, all difficulty 1 before difficulty 2 (print capture p. 235)

bools.name: djiLearnAllNewMaster
bools.comment: the outgrown master - once the character has learned all the master knows, no point remains; off to another master of the same style or a different one (print capture p. 235)

bools.name: djiMultipleStylesAllowed
bools.comment: the multiple styles - a player character can learn more than one style at a time, needing more than one master, available slots and dedication (print capture p. 235)

bools.name: djiOneStylePerFight
bools.comment: the fighting choice - the character chooses which style he uses, gaining all abilities of that style and none of the others (print capture p. 235)

bools.name: djiConstantManeuversException
bools.comment: the constant exception - only the special maneuvers of the chosen style usable, unless constantly in effect (print capture p. 235)

bools.name: djiStyleChangePerRound
bools.comment: the style switching - the character can change styles from melee round to melee round (print capture p. 235)

bools.name: djiCombineUniqueStyle
bools.comment: the combined style - after learning all from two or more masters the character creates his own unique style, combining the elements as desired (print capture p. 235)

bools.name: djiCombineElements
bools.comment: the element mixing - the Armor Class of one style with the number of attacks and damage of another, all learned maneuvers combined into the single new style (print capture p. 235)

bools.name: djiCombineTeachAsMaster
bools.comment: the new master - the creator of a unique style can instruct others as if he were a master (print capture p. 235)
